main_conclusion_zh: 最终绑定版本在完整循环状态、全局帧号、pre/post 捕获顺序及四臂深克隆方面通过静态审查和小型人工检查。尚未执行任何模型兼容或因果实验，不能据此宣称运行数值等价、科研增益或完整生成状态已捕获。

scope.allowed: Review source, contracts, source identities, standard-library AST, and tiny CPU tensors/containers

findings_and_evidence.topic: Complete loop state and absolute frame index
findings_and_evidence.evidence: Adapter STATE_FIELDS contains all 11 cross-frame locals; S_FIELDS contains state_feat/state_cov/kalman_stats/prev_candidate_state_feat/prev_feat_i. Source update_type and need_attn_for_update are recomputed and guarded as filt3r/False. ress/all_state_args are output accumulators; lighter all_state_args is never appended. Ephemeral frame intermediates are recreated before their next use.
findings_and_evidence.boundary: This is the audited lighter function's complete loop-local state, not arbitrary Python/process/generator state.

findings_and_evidence.topic: Snapshot timing before mutable Kalman state
findings_and_evidence.evidence: Insertion is immediately after ress.append(res_cpu), before any current Kalman update/commit. _compute_kalman_ema_gain_and_cov later mutates kalman_stats['delta_ema'] at upstream line 967; before_write deep-clones immediately. LocalMemory.update_mem/inquire and decoder residuals use out-of-place operations, so computing new_mem before the snapshot does not commit M or mutate pre S/M.
findings_and_evidence.boundary: Tiny in-place EMA mutation survival was tested; no real model forward or runtime side-effect equivalence was tested.

findings_and_evidence.topic: Post state and single shared event head
findings_and_evidence.evidence: after_write is last in the frame loop, after reset handling, prev_reset assignment and _advance_prev_buffers. Four checkpoints are constructed from one already-emitted current head. The event's write intervention can affect only later frames. Reset collisions and an event at global index 0 are rejected.
findings_and_evidence.boundary: No separately recomputed per-arm event predictions exist; one immutable event head identity must be bound by a future execution protocol.

findings_and_evidence.topic: No intervention preserves upstream statement sequence
findings_and_evidence.evidence: Independently parsed saved derived_forward.py, erased only four observation/restore guards, restored signature/name/enumerate origin, and obtained exact upstream AST equality. All 95 original statements remain and no original arithmetic/helper call is rewritten.
findings_and_evidence.boundary: This structural proof is not numerical equivalence of cloned/split/resumed execution.

findings_and_evidence.evidence: Four actions select whole pre/post write groups, each selected tree recursively cloned. Tensor storage disjointness checked against pre/post and every unordered branch pair; nested tensor mutation did not contaminate other branches. after_write runtime packages were checked with three tiny tensor values, including nested cache payloads.
findings_and_evidence.boundary: Artificial checks cover these functions on tiny CPU containers/tensors. They do not validate actual large-model state dimensions, peak memory or resumed forecasts.

findings_and_evidence.evidence: The final version records and compares per-module training flags, never calls eval(), and rejects active Dropout/stochastic depth/training BatchNorm without silently changing execution mode.
findings_and_evidence.boundary: Mode guards were statically reviewed; model construction and actual module inventory compatibility remain untested.

findings_and_evidence.evidence: source_binding now includes scripts/cut3r_rope_compat.py. _ropes checks actual class forward identity against signed_forward from the bound file, base=100/F0=1, and records code identities. The 126 source binding identities and final receipt's artifact identities were independently rehashed.
findings_and_evidence.boundary: A real bound model was not instantiated; this is static guard review and file identity verification.

findings_and_evidence.evidence: Frozen dataclass rejects direct reassignment. validate_checkpoint requires real int not bool/float, >=1, exact complete unique prefix length, nonempty string IDs, supported action, exact state keys and prev_reset is False. Independent tests cover these malformed cases and resumed global index.
findings_and_evidence.boundary: Frozen dataclass does not make nested tensors/dicts immutable. Caller must not tamper with checkpoint contents or fabricate frame IDs.

findings_and_evidence.evidence: Implementation deep-copies named buffers, known RoPE/PositionGetter caches, torch CPU RNG, Python RNG and loaded NumPy RNG; shared cache-owner objects are deduplicated and branch payloads cloned. Runtime guards check source identities, CPU/FP32/thread context, hparams, selected method identities, modes, parameter identity/version and observer hooks.
findings_and_evidence.boundary: It does not claim arbitrary global state, custom generators, GPU, cross-process resume, backend determinism or every external mutation is captured. Parameter identity/version is not a weight content checksum. A future protocol must bind weights, environment, preprocessing and actual RGB SHA/order.

nonblocking_notes.observation: The phrase '在循环外把 pre/post 组合' is imprecise: after_write constructs the checkpoints inside the final frame iteration, after all original update/reset/previous-buffer statements.
nonblocking_notes.impact: No behavioral or causal-order defect; the correct post-commit timing is clear in code and the rest of the contract.
nonblocking_notes.suggested_text: 在事件帧原更新、reset 与 previous-buffer 推进完成后组合 pre/post。

actual_independent_artificial_checks.scope: Standard-library static checks plus tiny CPU tensor/container checks; no model construction/forward

reproducibility.source:
import ast, copy, dataclasses, hashlib, importlib.util, itertools, json, resource, sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
root = Path.cwd()
folder = root / "work/S25_state_intervention_preparation"
path = folder / "state_intervention_adapter.py"
digest = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
source_sha = digest(path)
checks = {}
def check(name, value):
    checks[name] = bool(value)
    if not checks[name]:
        raise AssertionError(name)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("s25_independent_adapter_review", path)
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules[spec.name] = mod
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
check("import_does_not_import_torch", "torch" not in sys.modules)
binding = json.loads((folder / "source_binding.json").read_text())
receipt = json.loads((folder / "static_preparation_receipt.json").read_text())
identities = {p: digest(p) for p in binding["identities"]}
check("all_126_source_binding_identities_match", identities == binding["identities"] and len(identities)==126)
check("author_receipt_artifact_identities_match", all(digest(p)==h for p,h in receipt["identities"].items()))
check("signed_rope_helper_is_bound", str(root / "scripts/cut3r_rope_compat.py") == binding["signed_rope_helper"] and binding["signed_rope_helper"] in identities)
source = Path(binding["model_source"]).read_text()
upstream = ast.parse(source)
cls = next(n for n in upstream.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name=="ARCroco3DStereo")
original = next(n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=="forward_recurrent_lighter")
derived = ast.parse((folder / "derived_forward.py").read_text()).body[0]
original_loop = next(n for n in original.body if isinstance(n, ast.For))
erased = copy.deepcopy(derived)
erased.name, erased.args = original.name, copy.deepcopy(original.args)
removed = 0
def strip_guards(body):
    global removed
    keep=[]
    for n in body:
        if isinstance(n, ast.If) and any(isinstance(v, ast.Name) and v.id=="_s25" for v in ast.walk(n.test)):
            removed += 1
        else:
            keep.append(n)
    return keep
erased.body = strip_guards(erased.body)
erased_loop = next(n for n in erased.body if isinstance(n, ast.For))
erased_loop.body = strip_guards(erased_loop.body)
erased_loop.iter = copy.deepcopy(original_loop.iter)
check("independent_saved_AST_erasure_exact", removed==4 and ast.dump(erased,include_attributes=False)==ast.dump(original,include_attributes=False))
loop = next(n for n in derived.body if isinstance(n, ast.For))
emission = next(i for i,n in enumerate(loop.body) if ast.unparse(n)=="ress.append(res_cpu)")
check("pre_capture_immediately_after_current_head", "_s25.before_write" in ast.unparse(loop.body[emission+1]))
check("post_capture_last_statement_in_loop", "_s25.after_write" in ast.unparse(loop.body[-1]))
check("global_index_uses_checkpoint_start", "_s25.start_index" in ast.unparse(loop.iter))
check("complete_11_field_contract", len(mod.STATE_FIELDS)==11 and set(mod.STATE_FIELDS)=={"state_feat","state_pos","init_state_feat","mem","init_mem","prev_reset","prev_candidate_state_feat","prev_feat_i","state_cov","kalman_stats","device"})
import torch
torch.set_num_threads(1)
def make_state(offset):
    value={f:torch.tensor([float(i+offset+1),float(i+offset+2)]) for i,f in enumerate(mod.STATE_FIELDS)}
    value["prev_reset"]=False
    value["device"]=torch.device("cpu")
    value["kalman_stats"]={"delta_ema":torch.tensor([float(offset+3)]),"nested":[{"v":torch.tensor([float(offset+7)])}]}
    return value
def equal(a,b):
    if torch.is_tensor(a): return torch.equal(a,b)
    if isinstance(a,dict): return set(a)==set(b) and all(equal(a[k],b[k]) for k in a)
    if isinstance(a,(list,tuple)): return type(a)==type(b) and len(a)==len(b) and all(equal(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b))
    return a==b
def tensors(v):
    if torch.is_tensor(v): return [v]
    if isinstance(v,dict): return [t for x in v.values() for t in tensors(x)]
    if isinstance(v,(list,tuple)): return [t for x in v for t in tensors(x)]
    return []
def ptrs(v): return {t.data_ptr() for t in tensors(v)}
pre, post = make_state(0), make_state(100)
old_pre, old_post = mod._clone_tree(pre), mod._clone_tree(post)
branches = mod.select_branch_states(pre,post,clone=mod._clone_tree)
for action, branch in branches.items():
    for field in mod.STATE_FIELDS:
        use_pre = action in ("freeze_s_aux","freeze_all") and field in mod.S_FIELDS or action in ("freeze_m","freeze_all") and field=="mem"
        check(action+"."+field+".selected_value",equal(branch[field],(pre if use_pre else post)[field]))
    check(action+".no_tensor_storage_alias_to_pre_post", bool(ptrs(branch)) and ptrs(branch).isdisjoint(ptrs(pre)|ptrs(post)))
for a,b in itertools.combinations(branches,2):
    check(a+"."+b+".no_storage_alias",ptrs(branches[a]).isdisjoint(ptrs(branches[b])))
branches["freeze_s_aux"]["kalman_stats"]["nested"][0]["v"].add_(1000)
check("branch_mutation_keeps_pre",equal(pre,old_pre))
check("branch_mutation_keeps_post",equal(post,old_post))
check("branch_mutation_keeps_all_other_branches",all(equal(branches[a]["kalman_stats"],(pre if a=="freeze_all" else post)["kalman_stats"]) for a in ("normal","freeze_m","freeze_all")))
controller = object.__new__(mod._Controller)
controller.before_write(2,post)
captured = mod._clone_tree(controller.pre)
post["kalman_stats"]["delta_ema"].add_(500)
check("before_write_snapshot_survives_in_place_Kalman_update",equal(controller.pre,captured))
badpre=mod._clone_tree(pre); badpre["prev_reset"]=True
try: mod.select_branch_states(badpre,post)
except ValueError: rejected=True
else: rejected=False
check("reset_collision_rejected",rejected)
good=mod.Checkpoint(2,("rgb-a","rgb-b"),"normal",post,{},123)
mod.validate_checkpoint(good)
check("valid_absolute_checkpoint_accepted",True)
invalid=[
 ("index_bool",dict(next_index=True)),
 ("index_zero",dict(next_index=0)),
 ("index_negative",dict(next_index=-1)),
 ("index_float",dict(next_index=2.0)),
 ("index_wrong_count",dict(next_index=3)),
 ("duplicate_prefix_ids",dict(frame_ids=("rgb-a","rgb-a"))),
 ("prefix_list",dict(frame_ids=["rgb-a","rgb-b"])),
 ("empty_prefix_id",dict(frame_ids=("rgb-a",""))),
 ("nonstring_prefix_id",dict(frame_ids=("rgb-a",2))),
 ("unknown_action",dict(action="invented")),
 ("missing_state_field",dict(state={k:v for k,v in post.items() if k!="state_cov"})),
 ("reset_checkpoint",dict(state={**post,"prev_reset":True})),
]
for label, changes in invalid:
    try: mod.validate_checkpoint(dataclasses.replace(good,**changes))
    except (ValueError,TypeError): rejected=True
    else: rejected=False
    check(label+"_rejected",rejected)
try: good.next_index=3
except dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError: rejected=True
else: rejected=False
check("checkpoint_attribute_reassignment_rejected",rejected)
resume_controller = mod._Controller(None,[object()],("rgb-c",),good,False)
check("resume_global_index_is_two",resume_controller.start_index==2 and resume_controller.final_index==2 and resume_controller.all_ids==("rgb-a","rgb-b","rgb-c"))
runtime={"buffers":{"tiny":torch.tensor([1.])},"caches":{("tiny","cache"):{"entry":torch.tensor([2.])}},"rng":{"tiny":torch.tensor([3.])}}
fork = object.__new__(mod._Controller)
fork.adapter=SimpleNamespace(model=object(),_capture_runtime=lambda:runtime)
fork.all_ids=("rgb-a","rgb-b"); fork.fork_index=1; fork.pre=pre
fork.after_write(1,post)
check("four_runtime_branches_present",tuple(fork.branches)==mod.ACTIONS)
for a,b in itertools.combinations(fork.branches,2):
    check(a+"."+b+".runtime_no_storage_alias",ptrs(fork.branches[a].runtime).isdisjoint(ptrs(fork.branches[b].runtime)))
fork.branches["normal"].runtime["caches"][("tiny","cache")]["entry"].add_(8)
check("runtime_mutation_keeps_original_and_other_branches",runtime["caches"][("tiny","cache")]["entry"].item()==2 and all(fork.branches[a].runtime["caches"][("tiny","cache")]["entry"].item()==2 for a in mod.ACTIONS[1:]))
check("adapter_sha_unchanged_during_check",digest(path)==source_sha)
result={
 "schema":"s25-independent-small-checks-v1","started_utc":started,"completed_utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 "adapter_sha256":source_sha,"scope":"Standard-library static checks plus tiny CPU tensor/container checks; no model construction/forward",
 "check_count":len(checks),"passed":all(checks.values()),"checks":checks,
 "environment":{"python":sys.version,"torch":torch.__version__,"torch_cpu_threads":torch.get_num_threads(),"peak_rss_bytes_macos":resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss},
 "input_pre_post_tensor_elements":sum(t.numel() for t in tensors(pre)+tensors(post)),
 "runtime_original_tensor_elements":sum(t.numel() for t in tensors(runtime)),
 "model_instantiations":0,"frame_forwards":0,"S24_results_read":False,"RGB_or_GT_arrays_read":False,
 "bound_source_identity_count_verified":len(identities),
 "artifact_identities":{str(folder/n):digest(folder/n) for n in ["state_intervention_adapter.py","source_binding.json","static_preparation_receipt.json","static_field_contract.json","STATE_CONTRACT.md","prepare_static.py","instrumentation.diff","derived_forward.py","original_forward.normalized.py"]},
 "model_source_sha256":digest(binding["model_source"]),
}
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False))

reproducibility.note: 92 assertions are software checks, not 92 experiments or external numerical replications.

historical_check_record.record_basis: Earlier tool output in this same agent session; retained here as a retrospective receipt summary
historical_check_record.tested_scope: Independent AST erasure, 11 fields, four-action group selection, storage/nested mutation isolation, pre-write in-place EMA survival and reset rejection
historical_check_record.old_snapshot_findings: The earlier code/doc snapshot did not yet preserve training flags or validate signed RoPE/absolute checkpoint index. Those checks were not covered by this 62-check PASS.

required_before_real_causal_interpretati: Parent first decide whether complete natural-baseline evidence warrants the causal experiment; this review does not select an event/horizon or authorize a new model run.
Freeze real prefix/event/suffix identities/order, original weight and source hashes, preprocessing, module modes, CPU context, budgets, comparison fields and tolerances before execution.
On the actual model, compare original uninterrupted forward against source-derived uninterrupted forward for every returned head; record failures rather than relaxing tolerance after seeing outputs.

Compare derived uninterrupted execution against checkpoint split/resume normal for all suffix heads and complete loop state, including covariance/EMA/previous buffers, initialization state and absolute index.

Bind one unchanged event-head SHA across all four checkpoint branches and identical suffix RGB file SHA/order. Check branch/runtime package storage boundaries on actual state and decide in advance whether a short reversed-order continuation is required.
Measure real clone/checkpoint memory and runtime; frozen writes still execute decoder/head and do not imply computational saving.

Only after compatibility succeeds may subsequent-frame four-arm differences be interpreted within the single-event write-group intervention. No new GT is needed for software/model compatibility itself.

stopping_and_claim_boundaries.stop_if: Any normal-branch compatibility failure, event-head difference, missing state, contaminated EMA/cache, source/weight/input mismatch or resource failure.
stopping_and_claim_boundaries.current_novelty_status: No new method or empirical gain established.
stopping_and_claim_boundaries.causal_limit: Two write-group effects are tested together with their declared auxiliary state. A favorable freeze outcome alone cannot show which component is wrong, distinguish all history effects, or establish video-generation improvement.
